serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: Trick or treat!
Some old lady: O-oh! T-that’s a s-surprise. N-no one trick and treat m-me in 10 years!
Some old lady: I thought k-kids are not d-doing this anymore… 
Some old lady: My grandchildren were just s-staring at their p-phones a-all the time back in the day…
Some old lady: My oldest grandson will s-soon get married! I wasn’t expecting it s-since I lost all my hope for marriage after h-he became 40 years old…
Some old lady: My other grandchild, Arien, is a v-very successful writer. I’m very proud of him-
You: Ma’am, can we get our candies?
Some old lady: O-oh! Sorry, about that son. I don’t have m-many occasions to talk to someone besides my geriatrician. 
Some old lady: He’s a nice y-young man, but sometimes I have a-a feeling t-that I’m irritating him s-somehow-
You: Ma’am, about the candy…
Some old lady: O-oh! Right, I almost forgot. I-I should have some in my purse. Give me a second.
You: …
Some old lady: That reminds me. I got t-this purse from my daughter Isabelle. S-she was such a caring child! 
Some old lady: But then she started h-hanging out with this Jack guy. He w-was such a troublemaker!
You: Ma-am…
